shared_sub_capabilities.name: Customer Onboarding
shared_sub_capabilities.resolution_rationale: Single onboarding service with configurable KYC tiers — retail (individual ID verification) and commercial (beneficial ownership, Companies House checks). Shared CDD data store with capability-specific extensions.
downstream_implications: Single customer identity across retail and commercial
KYC/AML capability (CAP-005.01) consumes onboarding events for ongoing monitoring
Digital Channels (CAP-007) provides the customer-facing onboarding UI

shared_sub_capabilities.name: Sanctions Screening
shared_sub_capabilities.resolution_rationale: Compliance owns the sanctions policy, list management, and screening rules. Payment Operations consumes screening via a synchronous API (sub-200ms p99 SLA). Policy ownership stays in Compliance; runtime execution is contracted.
downstream_implications: International Payments (CAP-003.04) requires real-time screening on outbound transfers
Trade Finance (CAP-002.03) requires screening on parties and goods
Card Processing (CAP-003.05) requires screening on merchant onboarding

shared_sub_capabilities.name: Open Banking Payment Initiation
shared_sub_capabilities.resolution_rationale: Open Banking APIs (CAP-007.03) handles the consent and API layer for third-party providers. Payment initiation requests are forwarded to Payment Operations (CAP-003) for execution via Faster Payments or BACS. Clear boundary: consent/auth in Digital Channels, execution in Payments.
downstream_implications: API contracts between Open Banking and Payment Operations define the integration boundary
Consent lifecycle is owned by Digital Channels, payment lifecycle by Payment Operations

shared_sub_capabilities.name: Credit Risk Assessment
shared_sub_capabilities.resolution_rationale: Risk Management owns the credit risk models, scoring engines, and exposure calculations. Commercial Banking (and Retail Banking lending) consumes credit decisions via API. Business Lending originates the application; Risk Management provides the decision.
downstream_implications: Personal Lending (CAP-001.03) also consumes credit risk scoring
Regulatory Reporting (CAP-005.02) consumes credit risk exposure data

shared_sub_capabilities.name: Card Settlement
shared_sub_capabilities.resolution_rationale: Card Processing (CAP-003.05) handles authorisation, clearing, and settlement at the scheme level. Credit Cards (CAP-001.05) and Merchant Services (CAP-002.05) own their respective cardholder/merchant relationships. Settlement positions flow to Treasury for liquidity management.
downstream_implications: Card Processing settlement files feed into Treasury Services reconciliation
Fraud Detection (CAP-004.04) monitors card transactions in real-time
